raw_audit.source_and_raw_identity: Verified all original source/build/table/compiler records, actual candidate patches, executables, namelists and raw CSV hashes; analyzed all retained outputs again.
raw_audit.saved_product_reassembly: Exact equality after independent assembly and JSON serialization from the retained source and raw records. A Python-only tuple/list mismatch in compared_fields disappears under the declared JSON representation; no scientific field differs.
raw_audit.earth_parity: Both 10-minute native and plate-base controls exactly reproduce preceding saved physical states.
raw_audit.constant_settling: Both no-growth controls match H/v to relative 1e-12 and preserve mass exactly.
raw_audit.mass_water_and_source: Checked axes/volume, recomputed deposition balance, height-integrated Q/F allowance and local Q*v/(H*F) rate gate.
raw_audit.roundoff_control: Two near-freezing final steps exposed subtractive cancellation in a relative-only mass-rate check. The differences are below half a mass ulp divided by step length. Validation includes this explicit resolution and rejects larger perturbations; original outputs remain intact.

refinement.scope: Fixed-age timesteps 1/32 and 1/128 s; descent maximum timesteps 2 and 0.5 s with mass-fraction limits 0.01 and 0.005. Endpoint differences are measured numerical changes, not empirical error bounds.

source_reading: Read the pinned 2024 deposition, habit-coupling, native heat accumulator and gravity parameter, inherited lunar forcing and prior Earth trace. No new full-paper review or new external dataset.
editorial_reading: Read the completed report and synthesis against the product, including units, input identity, conditional steady fluxes, native censors, imposed heat removal, seed histories and numerical versus physical evidence.
remaining: Earth mass/axis errors and the original archive configuration remain unresolved. These are monodisperse conditional paths under imposed temperature and deposition supply; incoming populations, vapor and energy feedback, collisions, aggregate strength and storm optics are not solved.
